339-677-1251-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
339-677-1251-7272.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing Jegantha, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

6-5261-7170.easyPrerequisites:
Vitalize is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
6-5261-7170.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
6-5261-7170.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Living Brain.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Vitalize without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Vitalize, untapping all creatures you control
Repeat from step 2.

1021-1315-5478-6303.description:
Activate Drownyard Temple's second ability by paying {1} due to Convergence of Dominion, returning Drownyard Temple from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking
Activate Drownyard Temple's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.
1021-1315-5478-6303.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

2111-4659-6792.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Repeat.

2068-4283-7895.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
You have at least one creature card in your graveyard.
Whisper does not have summoning sickness.
2068-4283-7895.description:
Activate Whisper by tapping it, sacrificing Little Bear and any other creature you control, targeting any other creature card in your graveyard.
Ashnod the Uncaring triggers, copying Whisper's ability, targeting Little Bear.
Resolve the copy of Whisper's ability, returning Little Bear from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Little Bear enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Whisper.
Resolve the original Whisper ability, returning the targeted creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1170-1636-7530-7875.notablePrerequisites: You control enough creatures to cast Bind to Life using convoke without paying mana.
1170-1636-7530-7875.description:
Cast Bind to Life using Party Thrasher's convoke ability by tapping creatures you control.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Vastlands Scavenger.
When Vastlands Scavenger enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.

1619-4605-5542-6145-6798.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5542-6145-6798.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Passageway Seer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Passageway Seer enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Passageway Seer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Passageway Seer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Passageway Seer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Passageway Seer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Passageway Seer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Passageway Seer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5542-6145-6798.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

465-670-1619-6148.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
465-670-1619-6148.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling Seasoned Dungeoneer.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, it triggers, returning Seasoned Dungeoneer from exile to the battlefield.
When Seasoned Dungeoneer enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Seasoned Dungeoneer trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling Seasoned Dungeoneer.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Wormfang Drake.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

339-677-5434-6798.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1308-1558-3257-3875-4231.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1308-1558-3257-3875-4231.description:
Play Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Anointed Procession.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

5231-5687-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
5231-5687-7084.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Skittering Precursor and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Skittering Precursor trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
5231-5687-7084.notes: You can instead sacrifice the creature tokens to their own abilities instead of sacrificing them to Thermopod.

997-6255-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
997-6255-7084.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Zahur and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Zahur trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1661-2292-4871-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
1661-2292-4871-5220.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

1651-3340-5184-6871.description:
Activate Bootleggers' Stash by tapping it, as it's a land due to Toph, creating two Treasure tokens due to Xorn.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Treasures, untapping Bootleggers' Stash.
Repeat.

5170-5686-5933-6132.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Popular Egotist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Popular Egotist trigger.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

1446-3557-7009.manaNeeded: {3}{U} plus {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
1446-3557-7009.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Deal combat damage using Brago. Brago triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with a lore counter on it.
The Legend of Kuruk's first chapter ability triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its second chapter ability then triggers, causing you to scry 2 and draw a card.
Activate Viral Drake by paying {3}{U}, causing you to proliferate and put a lore counter on The Legend of Kuruk.
The Legend of Kuruk's third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

116-4639-7014.notablePrerequisites: North Pole Patrol and Kiora's Follower do not have summoning sickness.
116-4639-7014.description:
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
North Pole Patrol triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the North Pole Patrol ability, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting North Pole Patrol.
Kiora's Follower triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping North Pole Patrol.
Repeat.

2908-3375-3682-5542.description:
Cast Mox Amber by paying {0}.
Activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding one mana.
Cast Dream Stalker by paying one mana.
When Dream Stalker enters, it triggers twice due to Delney, returning Mox Amber and Dream Stalker from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1780-2092-4499.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 2 or greater.
1780-2092-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking Burdened Aerialist.
When Burdened Aerialist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3000-5670-6094.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
3000-5670-6094.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

204-392-955-1858-2056.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one white permanent.
204-392-955-1858-2056.description:
Cast View from Above by paying {1}{U}.
Birgi and Saheeli trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Saheeli trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve View from Above, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Repeat.

1692-2743-2751-5277.notablePrerequisites:
Helm of the Host attached to Biovisionary.
Abstruse Archaic does not have summoning sickness.
1692-2743-2751-5277.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Helm of the Host's trigger.
Activate Abstruse Archaic by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Helm of the Host's trigger.
Resolve all Helm of the Host triggers, creating three token copies of Biovisionary with haste.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

229-656-2232-3771.notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
229-656-2232-3771.description:
Cast Endless One, choosing one for X, but paying {0} due to Animar.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Endless One enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Ugin's Conjurant from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Ugin's Conjurant, choosing one for X, but paying {0} due to Animar.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Ugin's Conjurant enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Endless One from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
